_source: Colors: Extron's Afterburn theme guide, transcribed in docs/design-rules.md section 4; `alert` from the seed's own buttons.
Type, borders, button archetypes and sizes: surveyed off seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl (its fonts, border resources and every button's per-state fill, stroke and text color).
Point sizes draw at 1.375 px per point, GUI Designer's 99 DPI (gdl/compose.py PT).

Slider and level: the seed's built sliders (Audio Settings) - a 10 px rail (SliderTrackWidth) in a 50 x 395 control, the empty rail the control's fill (#242634, TLPMinValueImageID), the filled rail #BABCCE (TLPMaxValueImageID), a 50 px #626ACF thumb (SliderIndicatorImageID) - matching the guide's track, slider-fill and secondary-accent rows.
Panel: the seed's filled container - raised fill, #6A6E89 stroke, Afterburn - 10 Radius 2 Thick - and the guide's 'shapes #6A6E89' row.
title: Extron Afterburn
tagline: Extron's Afterburn touch-panel template, for TLP Pro panels.

colors.name: page
colors.usage: Page and popup background; a slider or level's empty track over an image, or on a raised panel.

colors.name: raised
colors.usage: Button fill when idle; panels and cards; a slider or level's empty track over a color.

colors.name: pressed
colors.usage: Button fill when pressed or selected (the On state). The same value as page.

colors.name: text
colors.usage: Headings, button captions, paragraphs; the border of a pressed outlined button. On page, raised and pressed.

colors.name: text-secondary
colors.usage: Subheadings, date and time, divider lines, the border of an idle outlined button, the filled part of a slider, single-color icons. On page and raised.

colors.name: text-subtle
colors.usage: Icon secondary in the guide: the de-emphasised parts of an icon. Under 4.5:1 on page and raised, so never for text people have to read.

colors.name: shape
colors.usage: Container shapes: the outline of a panel or card (over a raised fill, as the seed's own container draws it) and of the seed's round indicators; a toggle's thumb when off.

colors.name: accent
colors.usage: Selection lines and selected icons, and the caption of a button in its active state - the seed's own buttons turn their caption this color when On. Not a fill: Afterburn never fills a button with it. One scheme per project.

colors.name: accent-2
colors.usage: A slider's thumb and a level's fill (the guide's secondary accent). One scheme per project.

colors.name: alert
colors.usage: A caption that warns: the seed's own buttons turn their caption this red when On, for an active mute or a fault. From the seed, not the guide; not a fill.

colors.name: scrim
colors.usage: What the panel shows behind a modal popup's card: the page beneath, under black at 65% (alpha 166). Build draws it over every modal whatever background it was given - measured on the Afterburn, Mach and Shockwave seeds and on a panel built from a canvas - so it is not one of a panel's six colors. The guide's #242634 at 20% transparency is not what ships.

type.name: title
type.usage: A page's title - the seed's largest label.

type.name: heading
type.usage: A popup's or a section's heading.

type.name: button-large
type.usage: The caption of a large button: a source, a main action.

type.name: body
type.usage: Labels, status and paragraphs; the clock.

type.name: body-strong
type.usage: A label that names a group of controls.

type.name: button
type.usage: The caption of a small button. Afterburn's own small buttons use 13 pt, under the 14 pt minimum the toolkit checks, so 14 is the floor here.

afterburn.usage: An outlined button: rounded, with its stroke drawn.

afterburn-flat.usage: A rounded fill with no stroke: ghost buttons, panels, cards.

rect.usage: A square-cornered fill: a full-width bar.

outlined.usage: The default button: a raised fill and a text-secondary border, pressed fill and a white border when On. The seed's most common look.

ghost.usage: No fill until pressed or selected: list rows, tabs, icon buttons.

inverse.usage: For a button sitting on a raised panel: pressed fill when idle, raised when On.

cover.pattern: rounded tiles cut at the Afterburn 10 px radius

examples.states_note: In Afterburn an active state is the pressed fill and a white border, its caption in `accent` for a selection or `alert` for a warning. Afterburn never fills a button with an accent.
examples.color_rule: `page` behind everything; `raised` for idle buttons and panels, with `shape` outlining a card; `pressed` and a `text` border for On; `text` and `text-secondary` for type; `accent` only for selection lines and an active caption, and `alert` only for a warning caption - Afterburn fills nothing with either; `accent-2` is the slider thumb and a level's fill.
